workouts.title: Halting Snatch Deadlift + Snatch Pull
workouts.description:
Halting Snatch Deadlift + Snatch Pull
3x2+3) @ Add your Personal Record below
2x2+2) @ Add your Personal Record below
Rest 1:30-2:00 Between Sets.

NOTES:
- If you have straps, feel free to use them for this work.
- On the halting snatch deadlifts, work to keep a full foot pressure throughout the entire rep. At all phases of this movement, you should feel your entire foot from the heels to toes pressing into the ground evenly.
- Try to keep the same foot pressure on the snatch pull for as long as possible under you hit extension.
The goal on the snatch pull, just like on the snatch, is to keep your feet flat until your hips make contact with the bar.

workouts.title: Pause Back Squat
workouts.description:
Pause Back Squat
Build To A Heavy Single (RPE 9+), 12x1 Tempo
-then-
1x15-20 w/ No Pause
@
60% of Above
Rest 2-3 Minutes Between Sets.

NOTES:
- "12x1" means that you will take :01 to descend, :02 at the bottom, stand fast, and :01 at the top to reset between reps.
- Treat this as your max out today. The goal is to hit the heaviest weight where you can still be consistent with your technique.
- Be sure these squats are at full depth, and use no bounce to ascend from the bottom of each rep to the top.
